- their tests;

Not `packages/spec` or `skills/**`. Stop and report if the route needs either.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent` (area o3-G), `model: TIER_DEFAULT`, `effort: high`
Clause-②: yes (widening: a new published CLI command group, `os skills install | update | status`)
Metadata-protocol: none
Responsibility: `platform — no os command installs or refreshes the published skills; the only path is create-objectstack's scaffold-time sync`
Thread-read: 6963599108
Premise: holds at origin/main `4443014630`. `packages/cli/src/commands/` has no skills command. `validate.ts:235-241` (`--target`) only warns on a local-versus-target `@objectstack/skills` version drift (`RestrictionVersionDrift`, `utils/restriction-profile.ts:115`/`:578`). `@objectstack/skills` 18.5.0 publishes `dist/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`. The only installer is `create-objectstack`'s `npx skills experimental_sync` at scaffold time. The MCP instructions name `pnpm add -D @objectstack/skills@<version>` (`mcp-server-runtime.ts`), which needs a project.
Route: `install [--version V] [--target T] [--dir D]` copies the published catalog at a named version (default: the active target's skills version, else the CLI's own matching version) into the agent's skills directory (default `.claude/skills/`, overridable), in an empty directory or in a project, with no package.json needed. It fetches the `@objectstack/skills` tarball at that exact version from the configured npm registry, with no third-party CLI. `update` re-installs at the target's version and replaces only the skills the catalog owns. `status` reports installed versus target, plus missing or extra skills, and exits non-zero on a mismatch only when asked (for example `--check`). Done when: in an empty directory it installs the catalog matching a running server's version, and `status` reports a mismatch after the server is upgraded.
Serial constraints cleared: #34686 (the sibling) is merged. No open PR names `os skills` (search at claim time). The dev runs overlap-check before every push.
Pre-claim lane: `domain:server`, an epic #34659 child released by the maintainer (records 6963486364, 6963538703) and raised to p1 by triage 6963599108. The seat routed it to area o3-G (23:05Z).
Pre-claim deps: parent #34659 (S3 = A on #34691 6943107981; D4 = A). Related: #34686 (merged).
Prior rulings read: install,update,report,published,skills,server,version → 148 hits; ADR-0003 §3, ADR-0024 §4, ADR-0027 §11, ADR-0035 §5, ADR-0038 §5, ADR-0087 D4, ADR-0125 D4 keyword-only; thread: triage 6963599108 only.

Lease `o3-G` (seat post #34584); child of epic #34659. L1 is L1-c, then the seat's opus L2 for the Clause-② declaration.

## Delivered · 2026-11-18T03:11Z

PR #35060 merged to `main` at `0c6089725b` and closed this card (`Fixes`).
- `os skills install / update / status` install the published `@objectstack/skills` at the server's version into the agent's skills directory, with or without a project, then refresh and check it. Paths from the tarball and from the install record are refused if they could leave the skills directory (`..`, `\`, `:`, or a resolved target outside the root), and every target is judged before the first write. On Windows the `npm pack` destination is quoted.
- The MCP open server's `initialize` skills line now names `os skills install --version VERSION`, with the `npx -p @objectstack/cli@VERSION` fallback. The pending #34686 release note was corrected to match. That was a DELIBERATE CORRECTION, confirmed by the seat's record 6967431826.

Declared `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, `patch`. Reviews: L1-c ACCEPT 6966450600, delta ACCEPT 6967097514; seat contract review PASS 6966546222, delta PASS 6967431826. Follow-ups: #35079 (atomic `applySkillsWrite`, triage); N5 (`sync-catalog.mjs` should apply the reader's name rules) is with the skills lane. Version Packages #33849 regenerates from the corrected note. `pm:dispatched` and `lease:o3-G` removed in this stroke.
